productTitle: Walnut Rectangular Vintage Lockable Velvet Lined Jewelry Storage Box with Mirror

scenes.prompt: A warm heirloom vignette photographed three-quarter on a 50mm lens at standing eye-level, soft late-morning daylight raking from an unseen window at frame-left across the dropped writing leaf of an antique mahogany secretary desk set against a warm putty plaster wall. The jewelry box sits left-of-centre on a softly wrinkled flax-linen square, shown EXACTLY as the reference image: rich walnut body, the hinged lid lifted fully open to show its carved openwork four-leaf-clover fretwork panel, the velvet-divided top tray below holding a few neatly sorted pieces, and three pull drawers with small gold-tone knobs beneath. Style a few pieces in as the reference shows: pearls coiled in one tray cell, a pair of gold studs, a thin chain across the divider. The lowest drawer is pulled an inch open revealing sorted rings in velvet. Medium-density desk styling: a cloth-bound ledger, a brass desk clock, a fountain pen, and a stoneware cup of dried eucalyptus. One drawer sits a hair out of square and a faint dust mote drifts in the light for realism. Palette: walnut brown, champagne brass, pearl ivory, sage, oat linen. Sharp focus, photorealistic editorial styling, no people, no hands, no text, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Hero scene — carved four-leaf-clover lid open + tray styled + drawer ajar exactly as the reference; antique secretary-desk environment (none of the 3 jewellery-box siblings used a secretary desk).

scenes.anchor: heirloom blanket chest, foot of bed
scenes.prompt: A serene still life framed 1:1 on a 35mm lens at low chest-top eye-level, soft warm afternoon light glancing across the lid of a woven-cane and oak blanket chest at the foot of an out-of-focus four-poster bed, a folded camel wool throw draped at the chest's far edge. The jewelry box stands centred and fully CLOSED, presented clean and gift-ready, shown EXACTLY as the reference image: solid walnut body with the plain flat mirror-lid top shut flush, three drawers, gold-tone brass knobs and a hinged brass swing handle on the visible side. Tight 30% framing keeps the box the hero with restrained styling: a single stem of dried wheat in a slim brass bud vase, a folded raw-linen ribbon-tied square, and one small stacked pair of leather-bound books beside it. Low prop density, gallery-presented, with a faint natural fingerprint smudge near the brass handle for honest realism. Warm directional light pools on the walnut grain. Palette: walnut, aged brass, parchment cream, camel, straw. Sharp focus, photorealistic, no people, no hands, no text, no watermark, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Closed/gift state on the plain-mirror-lid walnut variant; foot-of-bed blanket-chest environment (new, differs from all siblings).

scenes.anchor: reading-nook side table by wingback chair
scenes.prompt: A warm reading-nook vignette captured three-quarter on a 35mm lens at standing eye-level, late-afternoon golden light skimming a small round walnut side table beside a deep-green velvet wingback chair, a greige limewashed wall and a leaning stack of books softly out of focus behind. The jewelry box sits right-of-centre, shown EXACTLY as the reference image: walnut body with the hinged lid swung fully UP to reveal the beige-velvet inner necklace-hook panel hung with a row of fine gold chains and a pendant, the brass lock clasp at the lid's front edge, and a hinged brass swing handle on the side. The velvet-divided top tray holds a few sorted pieces and the lowest drawer is cracked an inch open showing rings inside. Medium-density styling: a small brass tray with a folded watch, a cloth-bound monograph, a tortoiseshell reading-glasses case, and a quince branch in a porcelain bud vase. A leaning gilt mirror returns a sliver of the room. One hung chain sits very slightly crooked for lived-in honesty. Palette: honey walnut, forest velvet, champagne brass, cream, quince blush. Sharp focus, photorealistic, no people, no hands, no text, no watermark, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Lid-up showing the beige-velvet necklace-hook panel + lock + handle (the variant's signature features); reading-nook side-table environment (new).

scenes.prompt: A relaxed walk-in-dressing-room scene framed three-quarter on a 50mm lens at standing eye-level, soft warm early-evening light from an unseen sconce at frame-right pooling across the honed-oak top of a freestanding closet island, rows of softly out-of-focus hanging garments and open shelving behind. The jewelry box sits left-of-centre, shown EXACTLY as the reference image: WHITE-painted wood body with the hinged lid lifted to reveal its carved openwork four-leaf-clover fretwork over a mirror panel, the white velvet-divided top tray below, and a tall stack of slim drawers with small gold-tone knobs. Style a few pieces in: a coiled gold bracelet in one tray cell, pearl studs, a thin ring on the divider. The top drawer is slid half-open revealing sorted earrings in velvet. Medium-density layered styling that echoes the brass hardware: a folded grey cashmere wrap, a brass-rimmed catchall of cufflinks, a ceramic vessel of dried grasses, and a stacked pair of fashion monographs. The lid sits a hair askew and the drawer is a touch uneven for realism. Palette: warm white, walnut-shelf brown, champagne brass, dove grey, ochre. Sharp focus, photorealistic editorial, no people, no hands, no text, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: White wood + carved-clover mirror lid open + drawer-open state on the 6-tier white variant; dressing-room-island environment (new, differs from siblings' vanity/bench/console).

scenes.prompt: A crisp top-down flat-lay on a 50mm lens looking straight down onto a pale woven-rattan sunroom table top, bright diffused daylight from large conservatory windows casting soft leaf-dappled shadows. The jewelry box is shown EXACTLY as the reference image: dark walnut six-tier body — captured from directly above with its hinged lid laid fully open beside the body so the black-velvet inner necklace-hook panel and the sectioned velvet top tray both read clearly. Each compartment of the tray holds a few neatly sorted pieces as such a box would: stud earrings paired in rows, a coiled gold bracelet, two rings seated in the ring rolls, a slim chain laid in the longer channel. Around the box at low density: a folded sage washcloth, a small ceramic saucer with one gold ring, a sprig of dried lavender laid flat, and a single trailing pothos vine at the frame edge. The lid sits a few millimetres askew and the black velvet shows light natural crushing for realism. Palette: dark walnut, black velvet, woven straw, brass, dusty sage. Sharp focus, photorealistic catalog flat-lay, no people, no hands, no text, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Top-down flat-lay showing compartment grid + black-velvet hook panel (state the variant shows); conservatory/sunroom rattan environment (new top-down setting).

scenes.anchor: glass display vitrine / curio cabinet shelf
scenes.prompt: A quiet display-cabinet still life framed 1:1 on a 35mm lens at shelf eye-level, soft warm picture-light glancing across one glass shelf of a brass-framed display vitrine, the faint reflection of the glass and a blurred row of curios behind. The jewelry box sits centred and CLOSED, presented clean and collectible, shown EXACTLY as the reference image: light honey-toned PINE body with a plain flat lid shut flush, the brass lock clasp at the front edge, a hinged brass swing handle on the side, and the stacked pull drawers with small gold-tone knobs. Tight 30% framing keeps the box the hero with restrained styling: a single dried billy-button stem in a slim brass bud vase, a folded raw-linen square, and one small leather-bound pocket book. Low prop density, gallery-presented, with a faint natural fingerprint smudge near the brass lock for honest realism. Warm directional light pools on the pale pine grain. Palette: honey pine, aged brass, parchment cream, soft straw, glass. Sharp focus, photorealistic, no people, no hands, no text, no watermark, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Closed/collectible state on the pale-pine lock-hook variant (mid size); glass-vitrine curio-cabinet environment (new, sixth distinct setting).

scenes.anchor: carved lid + brass lock + velvet tray macro
scenes.prompt: A tight macro close-up on a 100mm macro-equivalent lens, shallow depth of field, focused on the corner where the carved openwork four-leaf-clover fretwork lid meets the brass lock clasp and the velvet-divided top tray of the jewelry box shown EXACTLY as the reference image: walnut fretwork with its pierced clover-and-vine cut-outs, the polished gold-tone brass lock plate, the soft beige velvet tray nap below, and the fine straight walnut grain. The frame fills with these details plus a small cluster in the nearest tray cell — a fine gold chain coiled neatly, pearl studs pressed into the nap, and a single signet ring — so the buyer can read the carving depth, brass lock finish, velvet texture, and wood grain. Soft directional daylight rakes across the carving to reveal its relief and a thin specular highlight on the brass lock. Background falls to a creamy bokeh. Natural realism: one velvet fibre catches the light slightly raised, a faint micro-scratch on the brass lock. Palette: warm walnut, aged gold brass, beige velvet, pearl, soft cream bokeh. Sharp macro focus on the carving and hardware, photorealistic, no people, no hands, no text, no watermark, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Mandatory close-up — carved clover fretwork + brass lock + velvet tray macro (this product's signature details) per cornucopia.
